entries.source_text: DO ensure there are no holds on the container (freight, customer, demurrage, customs, etc) prior to picking up an import load.
entries.interpretation_boundary: Draft support for checking the five named hold categories before an import pickup. The source's 'etc' does not establish that those fields exhaust every possible hold, a same-day gate release, gate acceptance, or permission to enter.

entries.source_text: Do not arrive at terminal without checking container status first and ensuring the container is fully available.
entries.interpretation_boundary: Draft support for checking container availability before an import pickup. It does not define a terminal-system status, freshness rule, other move types, gate acceptance, or permission to enter.
